name: procureshield-ai
description: ProcureShield AI - GeM bid verification UI on top of the ProcureShield graph/GNN risk engine (SIH prototype)

scripts.install:all: npm install --prefix server && npm install --prefix client && pip install -r engine/requirements.txt
scripts.dev: concurrently -n ENGINE,SERVER,CLIENT -c magenta,blue,green "npm run engine" "npm run dev --prefix server" "npm run dev --prefix client"
scripts.dev:node: concurrently -n SERVER,CLIENT -c blue,green "npm run dev --prefix server" "npm run dev --prefix client"
scripts.test: npm test --prefix server && cd engine && python -m pytest -q
